root_cause: Functions 8-11 import 'from tmp_agent.brain_v9.main import app' which triggers import-time initialization of the FastAPI app. The app imports memory-dependent modules (MemoryGatewayV2, NativeAgentRuntimeV2, etc.) at module level. In CI, where memory semantic files are gitignored and absent, this causes an import-time failure (FileNotFoundError or similar) before our runtime guards execute.
fix_required: Add CI guards to the 4 unguarded backend-dependent functions. In CI, skip with CI_BACKEND_AGENT_V2_UNAVAILABLE. Locally, fail hard if backend initialization fails (which indicates actual local environment issues).
